commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Antony (Betis) sends a long ball in, but Jan Oblak comfortably gathers the ball.
90+1' Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+1' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Cedric Bakambu (Betis) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.

86' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
85' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is given a yellow card.
84' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
82' The attendance is 57537.
82' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) replacing Giuliano Simeone.
82' Substitution. Koke walks off the pitch and Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
80' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

79' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Martinez no option but to blow his whistle. Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
76' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) replaces Cucho Hernandez.
76' The game has come to an end for Pablo Fornals. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nelson Deossa (Betis).
75' Here's the latest number of offsides – 3:4.

69' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Ricardo Rodriguez is replaced by Junior Firpo (Betis).
69' A substitution has been made. Hector Bellerin goes off and Aitor Ruibal (Betis) comes on.

68' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Jan Oblak makes a great save to stop his effort.
67' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged offside.
63' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is flagged for offside.
63' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
62' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Giovani Lo Celso (Betis). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
60' It is time for a substitution. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is on for Julian Alvarez.
60' Today's match ends for Alex Baena who will be replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
59' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) produces a decent strike goalwards from the resulting set piece. His effort crashes against the crossbar and the ball stays out of the net. The goalkeeper was quite lucky!
55' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is substituted due to injury. Diego Simeone gives a chance to Conor Gallagher.
54' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Jan Oblak is alert and denies him.
52' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) hits an amazing volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a great save.

51' A cross by Antony (Betis) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
50' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
48' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
46' Marc Roca goes off the pitch and Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) comes on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Pau Lopez had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:2.
45+1' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Betis for a penalty. Play continues.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Antony (Betis) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
42' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
41' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Antony (Betis) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
35' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
34' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' So close! Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.

32' Wasted effort! Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
30' Chance! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Giuliano Simeone, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
29' Flag goes up against Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
28' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Jan Oblak stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
27' The resulting corner from Pablo Fornals (Betis) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
26' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
23' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jan Oblak comes off the line to clear the ball away.
20' Hector Bellerin floats in a cross for Cucho Hernandez (Betis), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and floats high over the bar.
17' The resulting corner from Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
16' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Atl. Madrid will take a corner kick.
15' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Pau Lopez pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
13' Antony (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Juan Martinez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
7' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) will take a corner kick.
6' Antony (Betis) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
